about.heading: About Bonyad
about.tagline: An integrated ecosystem for the construction sector
about.intro: Bonyad is more than a digital marketplace — it's an integrated work ecosystem for the construction sector, built on two levels
about.level1Body: Connecting property owners with verified service providers through escrow and electronic contracting
about.level2Body: Used by service providers to manage their contracts, projects, payments and invoices — including work won outside the platform
about.derivationBody: The name unites building with supply, reflecting Bonyad's role as the connecting link between demand and supply across construction

hero.headline: Build with confidence and manage your projects like a pro
hero.searchPlaceholder: Search for an engineer, designer, electrician...

services.headline: One platform. Every stage of your project.
services.subheadline: Connect customers with professionals in a clearer, smoother experience for executing projects and building reliable working relationships.
services.feature1Body: Authenticated digital contracts that define the scope of work, milestones, and cost — protecting both parties from the very start.
services.feature2Body: Your payments are held securely and released to the service provider only after you approve the completion of each milestone.
services.feature3Body: Track your project's milestones, schedules, and payments in one place, with full clarity from start to handover.
services.feature4Body: A fair mechanism to resolve disputes through arbitration or experts before any action on the funds held in escrow.
services.ctaCardTitle: Everything you need to execute your project — in one platform.
services.ctaCardBody: A comprehensive experience to find the right service providers, manage communication easily, and make clearer decisions.

browse.headline: Find the right service for your project
browse.card1Body: Get high-quality building materials with reliable delivery to keep your project moving without delay.
browse.card2Body: Manage complex projects with confidence. Coordinate between parties, control budgets, and ensure quality from planning to delivery.
browse.card3Body: Comprehensive management of your property operations, maintenance, and tenants.
browse.card4Body: Expert advice to help you plan and execute your next project with confidence.
browse.card5Body: End-to-end delivery of large construction projects with full oversight and professional coordination.

howItWorks.headline: From posting to handover — with confidence
howItWorks.subheadline: Your project is protected at every step: an authenticated digital contract, and funds held in escrow that aren't released without your approval.
howItWorks.step1Body: Describe the work needed, and add photos, location, and budget range.
howItWorks.step2Body: Compare competitive prices, timelines, and past projects for each provider.
howItWorks.step3Body: Choose the best expert, sign an authenticated contract, and deposit the amount securely.
howItWorks.step4Body: Monitor progress milestone by milestone — funds are released only after you approve each milestone.

trust.headline: No risks. No surprises.
trust.subheadline: Hire with confidence, track with clarity, pay with security.
trust.stat120Body: Professionals verified via Nafath. Every professional on Bonyad has their identity verified through the Nafath platform.
trust.contractBody: Bonyad automatically creates a structured contract including scope, price, and milestones.
trust.supportBody: Dispute resolution team. If any conflict arises, the Bonyad support team intervenes to mediate and resolve the issue.
trust.transparentTitle: Bonyad is completely transparent in every transaction.
trust.transparentBody: No hidden fees. The price you agree on with the professional is what you actually pay.
trust.stat100Body: Protected by financial guarantee. Your funds are held securely and only released after your approval at each stage.

hero.title: Building the foundation of trust for the Kingdom's construction sector
hero.body: Bonyad wasn't built to be just another platform — it was built to solve a real problem millions of Saudis face every day

pillars.sectionBody: Through a design that balances simplicity, efficiency, and reliability — delivering a more refined experience for projects and services.

value.title: Clarity, trust, and simplicity
value.body: We believe the best platforms are built on trust, clarity, and ease of use — so we work to deliver an experience that helps clients and service providers connect and operate with greater efficiency and professionalism.

mission.title: An experience that unites trust and simplicity
mission.body: We're building a platform that helps individuals and service providers manage projects and communicate more efficiently — an experience designed to simplify every step, from the first idea to final execution.

vision.title: Building a more efficient future for projects
vision.body: We aim to reimagine the building and development experience through a platform that connects clients with professionals in a clearer, more reliable, and easier way.

timeline.sectionBody: From an idea to simplify the experience of projects and services, to a platform building a clearer, more professional experience for users and service providers.

founding.title: Bonyad was founded
founding.body: The idea for Bonyad was born from a painful personal experience — a delayed project, lost money, and no protection.

research.title: Research
research.body: We conducted more than 200 interviews with project owners and technicians in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam.

building.title: Building
building.body: We began building the platform with Nafath integration and financial escrow from day one.

launch.title: Launch
launch.body: The official launch of Bonyad — the Kingdom's first construction platform verified through Nafath.

stats.title: We measure our success by the success of our clients
stats.body: We strive to build a platform that simplifies access to expertise, strengthens opportunities for collaboration, and helps execute projects with greater efficiency and trust.
